findings.title: UniversalTraits source and 42.0 release media trees differ
findings.recommended_correction: Regenerate the release tree only through the authorized deployment workflow after product fixes and passing tests.
findings.smallest_regression_test: Hash every relative source/release media file and require empty missing, extra, and content-mismatch sets.

findings.title: Translator preprocessing mutates literal percent signs in English descriptions
findings.reproduction_evidence: Applying the current two-step Translator replacement changes 1 no-argument descriptions.
findings.recommended_correction: Encode literal percent signs using the Translator-safe representation verified for this game build.
findings.smallest_regression_test: Load every flagged key through the current Translator path without format arguments and compare the rendered text byte-for-byte with intended copy.
